This is a small style choice, so I'll just tell you my preference. Both get me to the same place, and the saved result is identical, so I'm fine either way.

If I'm picking: since I'll mostly be doing this over and over, I actually like the very first version better — the paste box is right there on the screen, so I can drop a link in and hit save without an extra click. Having to press "Save a link" first to reveal the box feels like one small step more than I need.

So my pick is the first screen with the box already showing. But this isn't a big deal to me — either works. Let's move on to the actual features.
